kevinSlides.header: U.S. Army First Sergeant & Airborne Ranger
kevinSlides.body:
As a teen, Kevin enlisted in the U.S. Army where he served his country for 22 years before retiring as a First Sergeant (1SG).



During his military career, he was assigned to the 504th Parachute Infantry Regiment as Jump Master for the Airborne Rangers. Kevin took immense pride in not only keeping his soldiers safe but providing real mentorship.
kevinSlides.imageAlt: U.S. Army First Sergeant & Airborne Ranger

kevinSlides.body: In addition to his decorated military career, Kevin raised 4 lovely children with Michelle, his wife of 27 years. Among family and friends, he was known for his fondness for cigars, wine, and motorcycle rides.

kevinSlides.header: Department of Defense & Civilian Tech Contractor
kevinSlides.body: Following his time in the army, Kevin would become a contractor in civilian tech for organizations like the U.S. Department of Defense.
kevinSlides.imageAlt: Department of Defense & Civilian Tech Contractor

kevinSlides.body:
Kevin adored his community and would advocate not only for veterans but also the families of military service members.



When he wasn't providing a beacon of hope, he was involved with the Brandon High School wrestling team where he took wrestlers under his continued mentorship.

Kevin's roots go back to Sandusky, Ohio, where he was born in October 1959.



In 2016, Kevin was killed when he was struck by a distracted driver. For 10 years, his friends, family, and community have served the Kevin Popke Foundation in his name.

eventDetails.logline: Raising awareness and donations to support military veterans and related organizations through events, songwriters, music, sponsors, good food, and great times.
eventDetails.description:
Songwriters 4 Vets brings together 6 Nashville hitmakers together with local favorite Ben Allen to perform their top songs (and share some of the stories behind them). Created to honor military servicemen and servicewomen while delivering high-impact entertainment, 100% of the event proceeds directly benefit the Kevin Popke Foundation, which carries the legacy of Army 1SG Kevin Popke.
What began as a mission to support youth athletics in memory of Popke's dedication to his son has expanded into a broader effort to empower our nation’s heroes. All funds raised through this event will directly support vital veteran-focused charities.
